description.description: A free-form text that may be used in various cases like in the Helm chart, the Dockerfile, etc.

build_tool.description:
The build tool used to generate task automation (Makefile, Taskfile or Justfile).

Leave unset to skip build tooling generation entirely.

exclude.description:
Parts of Kickr generation to skip.

- 'code-of-conduct': Skips CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and its mention in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- 'contributing': Skips CONTRIBUTING.md.
- 'pre-commit': Skips .pre-commit-config.yaml and its CI jobs.
- 'readme': Skips README.md.
- 'renovate': Skips renovate.json and the local Renovate configuration.
- 'security': Skips SECURITY.md.
- 'shell': Skips shellcheck on shell scripts, in pre-commit and CI.

github.description: Enable GitHub Actions with options to tune behaviors.

exclude.description:
Parts of GitHub Actions generation to skip.

- 'plumber': Skips the Plumber pipeline compliance workflow.
- 'pre-commit': Skips the pre-commit job.

options.description:
Options to tune GitHub Actions.

- 'codecov': Adds .codecov.yml and uploads coverage to Codecov.
- 'codeql': Adds the CodeQL analysis workflow.
- 'harden-runner': Adds the StepSecurity harden-runner step to every job.
- 'kickr:github-app': Adds the kickr layout update workflow, authenticated with a GitHub App.
- 'kickr:personal-token': Adds the kickr layout update workflow, authenticated with a personal token.
- 'labeler': Labels pull requests by changed paths.
- 'ossf-scorecard': Adds the OpenSSF Scorecard workflow.
- 'renovate:github-app': Adds a self-hosted Renovate workflow, authenticated with a GitHub App.
- 'renovate:personal-token': Adds a self-hosted Renovate workflow, authenticated with a personal token.
- 'sonarqube': Adds sonar.properties and the SonarQube analysis.
- 'step-security-actions': Uses StepSecurity maintained forks of third-party actions.

auth.description:
Authentication method to create releases through the GitHub API.

- 'github-app': Creates a token from a GitHub App.
- 'github-token': Uses the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN.
- 'personal-token': Uses a personal access token secret.

gitlab.description: Enable GitLab CICD with options to tune behaviors.

exclude.description:
Parts of GitLab CICD generation to skip.

- 'plumber': Skips the Plumber pipeline compliance job.
- 'pre-commit': Skips the pre-commit job.

options.description:
Options to tune GitLab CICD.

- 'kickr': Adds the kickr layout update job.
- 'overrides:deployment': Adds .gitlab/deployment.overrides.yml, included in the deployment pipeline.
- 'overrides:integration': Adds .gitlab/integration.overrides.yml, included in the integration pipeline.
- 'renovate': Adds a self-hosted Renovate job.
- 'sonarqube': Adds sonar.properties and the SonarQube analysis.

maintainers.description: Repository's maintainers list. Helps generating various files like CODEOWNERS or Helm Chart maintainers list.

name.description:
Maintainer name or username.
Username is preferred to be correctly identified within the CODEOWNERS file on the VCS platform.

email.description: Maintainer email. Only useful to be provided when working with an Helm Chart.

url.description: Maintainer personal portfolio / URL. Only useful to be provided when working with an Helm Chart.

modules.description:
Directories the repository is made of, each one owning its own technology stack.

When absent or empty, the repository root is the sole module, otherwise included by default.

options.description:
Options to tune Kickr generation.

- 'renovate:overrides': Adds configs/renovate/local.json for repository-specific Renovate rules.

platform.description:
Define the source code hosting platform (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Bitbucket).

By default, it will be guessed based on Git remote URL.
However, in case of mirroring, or other specific cases (like custom hosting), it may be updated to provide a custom platform.

Helps generating various files the badges in README.md.

pre-commit.description:
Section to add additional, non-default, checks with pre-commit.

All options available here are implemented in Kickr templates, there's no possibly to directly give pre-commit hooks definition.

In case a specific hook, not implemented, must be provided, then '.pre-commit-config.yaml' file can be modified
and the top comment indicating that it's generated can be removed to avoid being overridden.

- 'auto-commit': Commits pre-commit autofixes back from GitHub Actions.
- 'conventional-commits': Checks commit messages and branch commits with commitizen.
- 'gitflow-branches': Blocks commits on branches outside gitflow naming.
- 'golangci-lint': Adds the golangci-lint hook, always on without CI.
- 'gomod-tidy': Runs go mod tidy before each commit.
- 'terraform': Adds fmt, validate, tflint and trivy hooks, always on without CI.

docker.description:
General Docker configuration.

With 'ci' enabled, control where (registry and path) shall the built Docker image be pushed and when (automatically or not).

port.description: Port to expose in the Dockerfile.

helm.description:
General Helm configuration. By providing this property an Helm Chart will be generated.

With 'ci' enabled, control how and when shall the Helm Chart be published or deployed alongside on which environments.

exclude.description:
Parts of the Helm Chart generation to skip.

- 'workload': Skips the workload chart dependency, application template and values, and stops regenerating values.schema.json.

type.description:
Helm Chart type.

- 'application': Generates a deployable chart, rendering Kubernetes resources from its templates.
- 'library': Generates only Chart.yaml, .helmignore and an empty values.yaml, for named templates shared with other charts.

A library chart is never deployed, so it's not compatible with 'deploy' and 'environments'.

module.description:
One directory of the repository, owning its own technology stack.

Languages are detected by kickr inside the directory, they aren't configured here.

With 'ci' enabled, control where the module is deployed and, for terraform modules,
when shall they be applied (and on which environments) or published.

path.description: Module location, relative to the repository root.

exclude.description:
Parts of this module generation to skip.

- 'build_tool': Skips the build tool automation file (Makefile, Taskfile or Justfile).
- 'docker': Skips the Dockerfile.

terraform.description:
Configure the terraform module and the engine to use (tofu by default).

With 'ci' enabled, control when shall the terraform modules be applied (or not) and on which environments, or published.

engine.description: The engine to use to lint, validate, test, apply the resources.

path.description: Docker image path inside the registry (default is the path on VCS remote URL).

registry.description:
Docker registry where the image will be pushed.

By default it's the current VCS registry, i.e. 'ghcr.io' when working with GitHub
and 'registry.gitlab.com' when working with GitLab.

deploy.description:
Helm Chart deployment strategy (automatic or manual).
Not providing this property will mean 'never' as strategy, no deployment job will be generated.

environments.description:
Environments to associate a specific Kubernetes context to a branch.

Only those four environments can be provided, defining under the hood specific behaviors (for GitHub Actions):
  - 'review' will only be run on non-protected branches
  - 'integration' will only be run on protected
  - 'staging' will only be run on the default branch
  - 'production' will only be run on the default branch

Concerning GitLab CI/CD, rules can be found at https://gitlab.com/to-be-continuous/helm#managed-deployment-environments.

path.description: Path within the helm registry (default is the path on VCS remote URL).

publish.description:
Helm Chart publishing strategy.
Not providing this property will mean 'never' as strategy, no publish job will be generated.

registry.description:
Registry URL (both OCI and non-OCI based registry are supported).

Depending on the project registry (GitHub, Jfrog, Nexus, etc.), this property may need a more specific path like 'oci://jfrog.example.com/my/registry'.

deployment.description: Where and how the module is deployed.

auto.description: Whether the module shall be deployed automatically (or not) on its target.

target.description:
Deployment target of the module.

'netlify' and 'pages' build and publish the module as a static website.
'helm' includes the module executables in the generated Helm Chart values.

apply.description:
Apply strategy.
Not providing this property will mean 'never' as strategy, no apply job will be generated.

environments.description:
Environments to associate a specific terraform apply with.

Only those four environments can be provided, defining under the hood specific behaviors (for GitHub Actions):
  - 'review' will only be run on non-protected branches
  - 'integration' will only be run on protected
  - 'staging' will only be run on the default branch
  - 'production' will only be run on the default branch

Concerning GitLab CI/CD, rules can be found at https://gitlab.com/to-be-continuous/terraform#global-configuration.

publish.description:
Terraform module publishing registry.
Not providing this property will mean the module isn't published.
A published module is never applied, so it's not compatible with 'apply'.

'community' relies on the release git tag, read by the OpenTofu and Terraform registries.
'gitlab' uploads the module to the GitLab Terraform Module Registry on stable release tags.

release.description:
Tune various configuration on the releasing part.
From automatic releasing to how the authentication should be made with which semantic-release plugins.

auto.description: Whether the release job should be executed automatically (or not).

options.description:
Options to add to the release job and configuration.

- 'backmerge': Merges the release back into other branches with semantic-release-backmerge.
